entities.summary: Francisco Cases Andreu is a retired Spanish Roman Catholic prelate. He is bishop emeritus of the Diocese of Canarias in the Canary Islands. Previously he served as Auxiliary bishop of Orihuela and titular bishop of Timici and as the ordinary of Albacete.
